metas.name: Clueless
metas.description: Like 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a witty, iconic 90s teen comedy based on classic literature with a charming lead.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: Matches the lighthearted adventure and fantasy elements seen in Dungeons & Dragons and Jumanji.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you enjoyed the latest installment, the original mystery provides the same sharp wit and colorful ensemble cast.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: This offers the same high-energy, comedic space-adventure vibe found in Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: A staple of the high school comedy genre that fans of 10 Things I Hate About You will appreciate for its sharp humor.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, it has the same snappy buddy-comedy chemistry and crime-caper energy as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical fantasy adventure that aligns with the magical world-building of Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A perfect blend of action, adventure, and humor that mirrors the tone of the Jumanji franchise.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A high-concept, fun action movie that feels like a modern video game, similar to Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A modern comedic thriller that captures the chaotic energy and ensemble fun of your recent watched list.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: If you liked Ace Ventura, this is another classic Jim Carrey performance that relies on high-energy physical comedy.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: An exuberant, stylized action-comedy that matches the fast-paced tone of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A feel-good story with a fantasy twist that resonates with the heartwarming side of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A lighthearted fantasy that pokes fun at tropes while remaining a delightful comfort watch.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: Directly follows the mystery-comedy lineage of Wake Up Dead Man with a bright, fun setting.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: An action-heavy comedy with great lead chemistry, similar to the dynamic in The Nice Guys.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: Combines adventure, romance, and comedy in a way that feels very similar to the Jumanji sequels.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A clever, modern teen comedy that shares the sharp dialogue and charm of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant action-comedy that balances a mystery plot with high-octane fun, much like The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie that prioritizes fun, humor, and heart over grit, matching the energy of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A light fantasy-romance for those who enjoyed the whimsical and magical elements of Practical Magic.

metas.name: The Fall Guy
metas.description: A recent action-romance that is pure popcorn fun, aligning with your interest in high-octane entertainment.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A stylish and humorous take on the spy genre that offers great action and lighthearted moments.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good comedy that remains uplifting and easy to watch, fitting your comfort filter.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy that celebrates and parodies the genre, perfect for fans of Thor: Ragnarok's humor.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: Features Heath Ledger and a fun, modern soundtrack in a historical setting, much like 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever sci-fi rom-com with a time-loop premise that is both hilarious and easy to watch.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: An action-packed horror-comedy that remains lighthearted and fun, similar to the tone of Anaconda (2025).

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious action-comedy that features great stunts and a very funny ensemble cast.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: While animated, it captures the same sense of wonder and fantasy adventure found in Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A quirky and visually stunning comedy-mystery that offers a unique brand of comfort cinema.

metas.name: Chef
metas.description: The ultimate 'low stakes' feel-good movie that is perfect for when you just want to relax.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A fun, musical comedy with a strong ensemble that is very easy to rewatch.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic fantasy-action-comedy that matches the campy adventure of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Yesterday
metas.description: A lighthearted 'what-if' fantasy rom-com that is uplifting and filled with great music.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Consistently rated as one of the best feel-good movies ever made; pure comfort for any viewer.

metas.name: Mystery Men
metas.description: A quirky, underrated superhero comedy that fits well with your taste for ensemble-led fun.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A high-quality rom-com with multiple interconnecting stories and great comedic timing.

metas.name: Coming to America
metas.description: A classic fish-out-of-water comedy that provides consistent laughs and a feel-good ending.

metas.name: Hook
metas.description: A nostalgic fantasy adventure that captures the sense of play found in Jumanji and Fantastic Beasts.
